intro_caption: where it all went, largest first
outro_caption: trees, ropes and the server that reads them

items.label: Syntax trees
items.head: Syntax trees cost the most
items.note: one per buffer, kept whole so an edit reparses a subtree

items.label: Rope buffers
items.head: The text itself is second
items.note: chunked, so an insert copies a leaf and not a file

items.label: LSP client
items.head: The language server's side of the wire
items.note: one pending-request table and a mirror of every open doc

items.label: Undo history
items.head: Undo is unbounded on purpose
items.note: capped by age, not by count — a long session pays for it

items.label: Highlight cache
items.head: Highlights are memoised per viewport
items.note: dropped when a buffer scrolls out of every window

items.label: Everything else
items.head: The rest is small and dull
items.note: config, themes, the plugin host, the frame buffers
